item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:15 HKT 19/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Man-yi will move towards the vicinity south of Hainan Island today and tomorrow and dissipate gradually. Under the combined effect of Man-yi and the northeast monsoon, it will still be windy with some rain and cooler over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea tomorrow, and there will be swells. With the northeast monsoon moderating gradually, it will become brighter over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. Temperatures during the day will rise slightly. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong with a few rain patches over the weekend. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China midweek next week, temperatures will fall again over the region.
